name: cell4-arc-local
description: Offline CELL4 ARC portfolio plus the local language stack (QueryFrame, reasoning graph, evidence federation, realiser)

scripts.test: node c4-arc/test.js && node c4-arc/kernel-test.js && node c4-arc/integration-test.js && node c4-arc/generalize-test.js && node c4-gates-test.js && node tools/reason-kernel-test.js && node tools/lm-phrasing-test.js && node tools/lm-comprehend-test.js && node tools/lm-awareness-test.js
scripts.lm:heldout: node tools/lm-heldout.js --out measurements/lm-heldout-after.json && node tools/lm-heldout2.js --out measurements/lm-heldout2-after-fixes.json
scripts.lm:test: node tools/lm-robustness.js && node tools/lm-eval.js --out measurements/lm-after.json --label after
scripts.arc:curriculum: node tools/arc-curriculum.js --suite v2 --train 600 --eval 300 --seed 11 --steps 4 --ms 250 --write --out measurements/arc-curriculum-v2.json && node c4-arc/build.js
